info.name: School API — Admin Tenants
info.description:
Platform-admin tenants. **Documented (Batches 6–7):** `GET|POST /admin/tenants`, `GET /admin/tenants/username`, `POST /admin/tenants/:id/reactivate`, `POST /admin/tenants/:id/resend-credentials`, `POST /admin/tenants/:id/suspend`.

- `requireAdminSession` runs **before** host and method — missing/invalid token is **401** `{ "error": "Unauthorized" }` even on a school host.
- Wrong host after a valid admin token: **403** `{ "error": "This action is only allowed on the admin host" }`.
- List pagination is **not** the contact inbox: default page 1, pageSize **10**, max **50**.
- Create body is `{ name, email }` — **no slug**. List and create write `{{tenantId}}`.
- Username lookup is this file (`GET /admin/tenants/username`). School-account username lookup/claim stays in `School-Accounts.postman_collection.json`.
- `store.setStatus` is unguarded and idempotent: suspend → `suspended` from any status; reactivate → `active` from any status (including `pending_setup`).

Shared environment: `environments/School-API.local.postman_environment.json`.

- `{{baseUrl}}` is the **backend** (`http://127.0.0.1:5000`), not Next on `3000`.
- Prefer `x-school-host` over `Host`. Matching lowercases and strips `:{port}`.
- Tokens are HMAC (`payload.signature`), not JWT. Admin `{{accessToken}}` will not verify on school/campus routes (different HMAC material). School and campus share `:school-account-session`.
- Error JSON (except health): `{ "error": "<string>" }`. No 422. Wrapper-only 500 is `{ "error": "Internal server error" }`.
- Do not invent routes or status codes. All 28 live backend endpoints are in the split collections — do not grow a monolith.

item.name: Admin Tenants
item.description:
Tenant directory on `admin.<rootHost>`. Sign in via **Admin Session** first (`{{accessToken}}`).

**This collection:** list (newest first), create pending schools from name + email, username availability, reactivate, resend-credentials, suspend.

School-account username lookup/claim stays in `School-Accounts`. `GET /admin/dashboard` is not documented here.

request.description:
Lists platform tenants newest-first for the signed-in operator.

**Auth:** required. `requireAdminSession` runs **before** host and method. Missing/invalid/school HMAC → `401 { "error": "Unauthorized" }` even on a school host.

**Who:** the signed-in platform operator.

**Host (required after auth):** `rejectIfNotAdminHost`. `{{adminHost}}` = `admin.e-school.et:3000` is valid. School / app / apex → `403 { "error": "This action is only allowed on the admin host" }`.

**Query (NOT the contact inbox):** `page` default **1**, `pageSize` default **10**, max **50**. `normalizePage` / `normalizePageSize` use `Number.parseInt` (strings) or `Math.trunc` (finite numbers). Empty / non-numeric → defaults. `page < 1` → **1**. `pageSize < 1` → **1**. `pageSize` 100 → **50**. Invalid query never 400s. Contact inbox instead defaults `pageSize` to **50**, caps at **100**, and uses `Number()` + `Number.isInteger`.

**Order:** `createdAt` descending, then `id` descending.

**Tenant view:** `{ id, name, slug, username, email, status, created, founded, host, mustChangePassword, lastMailAt, lastMailOk, lastMailError, signedInAt }`. `username` is the same as `slug`. `slug` / `username` / `host` are `null` until the director claims a username. `host` is `{slug}.{rootHost}` with **no port** when claimed. `status` is `pending_setup` | `active` | `suspended`. ISO-8601 for `created` / `lastMailAt` / `signedInAt`.

**Side effects:** none.

**Success `200`:** `{ schools, page, pageSize, total }`. Empty directory is still 200 with `schools: []`, `total: 0`. Test script writes `{{tenantId}}` from `schools[0].id` when present.

**Same path as POST.** `405` is PUT/PATCH/DELETE only (after a valid admin token). A POST without a body is **create**, not 405.

**Also in this collection:** `GET /admin/tenants/username`, `POST /admin/tenants/:id/reactivate|resend-credentials|suspend`. `GET /admin/dashboard` is not documented here. School-account username lookup/claim stays in `School-Accounts`.

**Errors that exist:** 401 Unauthorized; 403 admin-host only; 405 other methods.

**Not used:** 400, 404 (path exists), 409, 422. No distinct 500 from this handler.

JSON body { name, email }. No slug. Invalid JSON → 400 Invalid JSON. Missing fields become "".

request.description:
Creates a pending tenant from **name + email only**. The handler does **not** read `slug`.

**Auth:** required. Same 401-before-host rule as GET.

**Who:** the signed-in platform operator.

**Host (required after auth):** `rejectIfNotAdminHost`. Wrong host → `403 { "error": "This action is only allowed on the admin host" }`.

**Body:** `{ name, email }`. Non-string or missing keys become `""` (not 400-for-missing-key). Non-object JSON is treated as `{}`. Empty body `{}` is valid JSON then fails name validation.

**Validate name first, then email:**
- `name` — `trim`. Empty → `A school name is required`. Over **200** → `School name is too long`.
- `email` — `trim` + lowercase. Empty → `Email is required`. Must match `[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+` or `A valid email is required`.

**409 always the same text:** `{ "error": "This email cannot be used." }` for platform-admin email (case-insensitive), an existing tenant email, or a unique-index race. The body never says which. No mail is sent on 409.

**Side effects:** inserts a `pending_setup` school (`slug` / `username` / `host` null, `mustChangePassword` true, `founded` = `Founded {UTC year}`), hashes a generated temporary password, and emails first-login credentials (`http://app.{rootHost}:3000/first-login?email=...`). Mailer failure still **201** — `emailSent: false` and `emailError` are set; `school.lastMailOk` / `lastMailError` record the attempt.

**Success `201`:** `{ school, credentials: { email, password, firstLoginUrl }, emailSent, emailError? }`. `school` is the tenant admin view. Test script writes `{{tenantId}}` from `school.id`.

**Same path as GET.** `405` is PUT/PATCH/DELETE only (after a valid admin token).

**Also in this collection:** username lookup, reactivate, resend-credentials, suspend.

**Errors that exist:** 400 Invalid JSON / name / email; 401 Unauthorized; 403 admin-host only; 409 email cannot be used; 405 other methods.

**Not used:** 404, 422. No distinct 500 from this handler.

request.description:
Checks whether a tenant username (subdomain slug) is free. **Exact path** `/admin/tenants/username`, matched **before** `:id` actions.

**Auth:** required. `requireAdminSession` runs **before** host and method. Missing/invalid/school HMAC → `401 { "error": "Unauthorized" }` even on a school host.

**Who:** the signed-in platform operator. This is **not** `GET /school-accounts/username` (that stays in School-Accounts).

**Host (required after auth+GET):** `rejectIfNotAdminHost`. Wrong host → `403 { "error": "This action is only allowed on the admin host" }`.

**Query:** `slug` — `searchParams.get("slug") ?? ""`. Trim + lowercase (`normalizeSchoolSlug`). Missing, empty, or whitespace → `username: ""` and `reason: "invalid"`. Pattern `^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$`. There is **no 400** for a bad slug.

**Always `200` after auth+host:**
- `{ username, available: true }` — no `reason`.
- `{ username, available: false, reason }` where `reason` is `invalid` | `reserved` | `taken`.

**Reasons:** empty/invalid pattern → `invalid`; reserved (`www`, `api`, `app`, `admin`, `mail`, `ftp`) → `reserved`; existing tenant slug (`store.findBySlug`) → `taken`.

**Side effects:** none. Does not claim the slug.

**Same path.** Not GET → `405 { "error": "Method not allowed" }` after a valid admin token (host is not checked on 405).

**Errors that exist:** 401 Unauthorized; 403 admin-host only; 405 other methods.

**Not used:** 400, 404 (path exists), 409, 422. No distinct 500 from this handler.

request.description:
Sets the tenant status to **`active`**. `store.setStatus` is **unguarded and idempotent** — works from `pending_setup`, `suspended`, or already `active`. Does **not** claim a username; `slug` / `username` / `host` stay as they were.

**Auth:** required. `requireAdminSession` runs **before** host and method. Missing/invalid/school HMAC → `401 { "error": "Unauthorized" }` even on a school host.

**Who:** the signed-in platform operator.

**Host (required after auth+POST):** `rejectIfNotAdminHost`. Wrong host → `403 { "error": "This action is only allowed on the admin host" }`.

**Path:** `readAdminTenantAction` — `/admin/tenants/:id/reactivate`. `:id` is the segment before the first `/`. Empty (`/admin/tenants//reactivate`) or extra (`.../:id/reactivate/extra`) do **not** match (generic `404 { "error": "Not found" }`). Unmatched paths never reach `requireAdminSession` — generic 404 even without a token. Unknown action kind (`.../:id/archive`) is also generic 404. `/admin/tenants/username` is a different route and is matched first.

**Id:** `isTenantId` — UUID regex (any version, case-insensitive). Non-UUID (`not-a-uuid`) **and** unknown UUID both → `404 { "error": "Tenant not found" }`. There is **no 400** for a bad id.

**Body:** none. The handler does not call `readJsonBody`.

**Side effects:** `status = active`. No mail. Create starts at `pending_setup`; claiming a username (School-Accounts) also sets `active` + slug.

**Success `200`:** `{ "school" }` — tenant admin view (`id`, `name`, `slug`, `username`, `email`, `status`, `created`, `founded`, `host`, `mustChangePassword`, `lastMailAt`, `lastMailOk`, `lastMailError`, `signedInAt`).

**Same matcher as suspend / resend-credentials.** Not POST → `405 { "error": "Method not allowed" }` after a valid admin token (host is not checked on 405).

**Errors that exist:** 401 Unauthorized; 403 admin-host only; 404 Tenant not found / generic Not found; 405 other methods.

**Not used:** 400, 409, 422. No distinct 500 from this handler.

request.description:
Rotates the director temporary password and emails first-login credentials. **No body.**

**Auth:** required. `requireAdminSession` runs **before** host and method. Missing/invalid/school HMAC → `401 { "error": "Unauthorized" }` even on a school host.

**Who:** the signed-in platform operator.

**Host (required after auth+POST):** `rejectIfNotAdminHost`. Wrong host → `403 { "error": "This action is only allowed on the admin host" }`.

**Path / id:** same `readAdminTenantAction` rules as reactivate/suspend. Empty or extra `/` → generic `404 { "error": "Not found" }`. Unmatched paths never reach `requireAdminSession` — generic 404 even without a token. Non-UUID and unknown id → `404 { "error": "Tenant not found" }` (no 400). A row with no stored password hash is also `Tenant not found` (`findAuthById` returns undefined).

**Body:** none. The handler does not call `readJsonBody`.

**409 exact texts** (checked in this order):
- `"Cannot resend credentials while the school is suspended"`
- `"Credentials cannot be resent after the username is claimed"` (`slug !== null`)
- `"This school has no director email"` (`email === null`)

**Side effects:** generates a new password, writes the hash, sets `mustChangePassword: true`, emails `http://app.{rootHost}:3000/first-login?email=...`. Mailer failure still **200** — `emailSent: false` and `emailError` are set; `school.lastMailOk` / `lastMailError` record the attempt. The previous password stops verifying.

**Success `200`:** `{ school, credentials: { email, password, firstLoginUrl }, emailSent, emailError? }`.

**Same matcher as suspend / reactivate.** Not POST → `405 { "error": "Method not allowed" }` after a valid admin token (host is not checked on 405).

**Errors that exist:** 401 Unauthorized; 403 admin-host only; 404 Tenant not found / generic Not found; 409 the three texts above; 405 other methods.

**Not used:** 400, 422. No distinct 500 from this handler.

request.description:
Sets the tenant status to **`suspended`**. `store.setStatus` is **unguarded and idempotent** — works from `pending_setup`, `active`, or already `suspended`. Does **not** clear slug, email, or host.

**Auth:** required. `requireAdminSession` runs **before** host and method. Missing/invalid/school HMAC → `401 { "error": "Unauthorized" }` even on a school host.

**Who:** the signed-in platform operator.

**Host (required after auth+POST):** `rejectIfNotAdminHost`. Wrong host → `403 { "error": "This action is only allowed on the admin host" }`.

**Path:** `readAdminTenantAction` — `/admin/tenants/:id/suspend`. `:id` is the segment before the first `/`. Empty or extra `/` do **not** match (generic `404 { "error": "Not found" }`). Unmatched paths never reach `requireAdminSession` — generic 404 even without a token. Unknown action kind is also generic 404.

**Id:** `isTenantId` — UUID regex (any version, case-insensitive). Non-UUID **and** unknown UUID both → `404 { "error": "Tenant not found" }`. There is **no 400** for a bad id.

**Body:** none. The handler does not call `readJsonBody`.

**Side effects:** `status = suspended`. No mail. Create starts at `pending_setup`; claim username (School-Accounts) sets `active` + slug; reactivate sets `active` from any status.

**Success `200`:** `{ "school" }` — tenant admin view. `status` is `suspended`.

**Same matcher as reactivate / resend-credentials.** Not POST → `405 { "error": "Method not allowed" }` after a valid admin token (host is not checked on 405).

**Errors that exist:** 401 Unauthorized; 403 admin-host only; 404 Tenant not found / generic Not found; 405 other methods.

**Not used:** 400, 409, 422. No distinct 500 from this handler.
